reviewNotes: Held back: the score has a change of metre, which the importer does not render; bar 10 does not add up to 4 beats; bar 11 does not add up to 4 beats; bar 12 does not add up to 4 beats; bar 13 does not add up to 4 beats; bar 14 does not add up to 4 beats; bar 15 does not add up to 4 beats; bar 16 does not add up to 4 beats; the melody does not parse: bar 10 has 6 beats, not 4. Imported from the Open Hymnal Project's ABC score; check the notes and the words against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. The score gives no year for the tune; it was in print by 1853, the year of the setting the Open Hymnal copied. The last 5 verses are printed after the score in the source, not under the notes. The Open Hymnal's own source: "Kern des Deutschen Kirchengesangs zum Gebrauch Evangelisch-Lutherischer Gemeinden und Familien", 1853 by Fridrich Layriz Hymn 603 page 138 Lyrics source: Original Lyrics from Sacred Hymns from the German (London: 1841); very minor alterations as in ELHB 1931
